complexity.notes: Correct but the initialization is convoluted; computing root/next1/next2 via the same comparison twice is harder to read than the standard dummy-head pattern (dummy = ListNode(); tail = dummy) which also removes the early None checks and the duplicated return statements.
complexity.summary: Iterative two-pointer merge: picks the smaller head as root, then walks both lists appending the smaller current node, and finally splices on the non-empty remainder. Reuses the original nodes with O(1) extra space.
